label: baseline_20261105
measurement_notes: noise_floor_dbfs is the 10th percentile of 25 ms frame RMS; snr_proxy_db is p90 - p10.
silent frames are frames at least 30 dB below the 90th percentile frame level; their spectra are used for noise-band measurements.
band_*_share_db is band power relative to total power, so a broadband hiss raises high-band shares even when overall level is normalized.
spectral_flatness is the median frame geometric/arithmetic mean ratio; 1.0 is white noise.
These are objective proxies, not perceptual quality or MOS.
